notes: Three alpha-privative adjectives all head on their nouns under rule 84's unbroken line.

εἰς τὸ διηνεκές is split on rule 93's test, continually being taken as διηνεκής's own gloss so that εἰς is pleonastic under rule 34. Joining εἰς + διηνεκές as one noncompositional unit under rule 45 remains defensible and the unit note names it; rule 93 leaves the article unrepresented on either reading.
